entries.name: Default (CS:GO)
entries.description_zh: CS:GO 标准平衡基线。包含经典准星、雷达、音频与常用基础键位设置。
entries.description_en: Balanced CS:GO baseline with classic crosshairs, radar, audio and standard bindings.

entries.name: Crosshair-View
entries.description_zh: CS:GO 经典参数体系的准星与持枪视角预设切换、颜色切换与道具拉长准星切换。
entries.description_en: Classic CS:GO crosshair and viewmodel preset library, RGB color helpers and lineup crosshair toggle.

entries.name: Knife
entries.description_zh: CS:GO 本地跑图切刀功能：使用 weapon_knife_* 与 weapon_knifegg 重命名切换全套经典匕首。
entries.description_en: CS:GO offline knife switcher using give weapon_knife_* and weapon_knifegg classname conversion.

entries.name: Practice
entries.description_zh: CS:GO 本地跑图练习模式：包含投掷物轨迹/实时预览、Bot 控制、出生点传送与训练快捷键。
entries.description_en: CS:GO offline practice mode with grenade trajectory/preview, bot control, spawn teleports and hotkeys.
